# Quote

`content/quote` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A pull quote with an optional author and role, with an accent bar, centered or plain layout.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `author` | text |  |
| `role` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Quote with an accent bar on the left.
- **centered**: Centered with a large opening quote mark. Sets `layout: centered`, `align: center`.
- **plain**: Italic text with quote marks, no decoration. Sets `layout: plain`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `layout` | one of `bar`, `centered`, `plain` | `"bar"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `barColor` | color | `"@theme.accent.color"` |
| `barWidth` | length | `"@theme.accent.lineWidth"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm 0 @spacing.md 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Accent bar is a shaded table cell, honored. Italics honored. | Fine. | Quote text and author swap via dm-text and dm-muted where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/quote', {
  "text": "I have washed this shirt forty times and it just keeps getting softer. Easily the best linen I own.",
  "author": "Priya N.",
  "role": "Verified buyer"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/quote",
  "data": {
    "text": "I have washed this shirt forty times and it just keeps getting softer. Easily the best linen I own.",
    "author": "Priya N.",
    "role": "Verified buyer"
  }
}
```
